reviews.review_title: Clothes are nice! Process takes too long
reviews.review_text:
Clothes are nice.  Wash well and wear well.  I have purchased twice now from sport bras yoga pants, and evening clothes.

What I am not impressed with is their delivery.  This last order took 6 weeks before it was shipped.  Kept getting updates sorry for the delay, something couldn’t be filled and then finally my order shipped.

A few days after I received my order I got an email to review each product.  Forgetting that an item could not be for filled that showed up for me to review.  I checked my bank and noticed my account wasn’t refunded.  Contacted CS and to my surprise they said oh you have to initiate the refund process.  That on Halara not me.  I did my part, placed an order, paid and waited an exuberant amount of time.  To only be told I need to request a refund befuddled me.  So now I wait once again for my refund which said it would take 7-14 days.  That essentially means it would have taken Halara 2 months to complete a transaction.  

While I enjoy the clothes the process needs to overhauled.  I hope you do better.

reviews.review_title: You need this dress!
reviews.review_text: I first bought these dresses from the TikTok shop and hoped they  lived up to the hype. The day I got them, on went to the Halara website and ordered 3 more. They fit true to size and are good quality. I love the built in bra! As a large breasted woman, I was skeptical that I would be able to go braless, but it provides good support and does not give you the "uniboob" look of a sports bra. The dress is comfortable, flattering and I get tons of compliments every time I wear one. They are also versatile and I look forward to wearing them year round by adding a cardigan or jacket in fall and winter. I got free shipping and it shipped quicky. Highly recommend!
